Logic Gates

A dead station computer, rebuilt one circuit at a time. Match the lamps to the table, keep each circuit as a chip, and end with a computer you wired yourself.

Levels

A level opens when you own the chips its answer needs, so there is more than one road through. A tick means solved; PAR means solved with no more chips than the reference. Nothing here is timed.

Chips

Every chip you earn is a circuit you built. Locked chips show the level that hands them out.

    Sandbox

    A free board with every chip you own. Any truth table a lamp makes for the first time is logged here. The Sixteen are all the ways two switches can decide a lamp.

      Station log

      One line from every board you have repaired. The Story button, bottom left, hides it.
